git-workflow procedure clauses
clean tree: no gate
ignored file alone: no gate
unstaged change: two options
unstaged change, headless: pause
staged change: two options
fixture restored to clean
untracked foreign file: two options
headless with an adequate standing choice follows it
headless with no standing choice pauses
changes made during the task do not retrigger: the check reads the state before the first change
generic approved workflow is no authority for reset
general task approval is no authority
workflow step mentioning a commit is no authority
explicit request allows after re-check
pre-approval for one branch does not leak to main
explicit main rewrite is valid unless another policy forbids it
K0 hook: git status -> allow
K0 hook: git diff --cached -> allow
K0 hook: git log --oneline -> allow
